evidence.reason: `test_all_checks_proven` only iterates over `vm.build_checks(...).items()` and checks each returned value. It never asserts a fixed set of required check names, so an empty result or an omitted required check passes this test without exercising the intended proof. Adding an independent required-key assertion is a routine test repair, not an owner-level behavior change.
